subject: VAT ID reconciliation & automated remediation playbook
messages:
From: Sophie Mallory <sophie.mallory@greenwave.co>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@greenwave.co>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: VAT IDs + split settlement for marketplace sellers

Hi Neha,

We just completed a seller onboarding batch and our payments team flagged ~1.1k accounts with missing/invalid EU VAT IDs. This is causing two problems: (1) our autopayout system is classifying invoices as B2C which triggers VAT collection in a few member states, and (2) we can’t apply reverse-charge for cross-border B2B sales where appropriate.

Can Redwood run a one-off bulk validation against the VIES/FR/IT registries and return a reconciled CSV with validation status + suggested settlement flow (collect VAT / reverse-charge / withhold)? Ideally we’d also want a small remediation pipeline for sellers who are near-valid (e.g., formatting, country code mismatch) so our ops team can send targeted emails rather than manual review.

I attached a short list of representative seller IDs and a sample invoice we can use for mapping. Happy to do a short call to align on the CSV schema.

Thanks,
Sophie Mallory
Head of Payments Operations
GreenWave Logistics

Attachments referenced: seller_sample_list.csv, sample_invoice_091026.pdf
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Mallory <sophie.mallory@greenwave.co>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:35:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT IDs + split settlement for marketplace sellers

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and the sample files. We can absolutely help with a bulk VATID reconciliation and provide three outputs: (A) reconciled CSV with canonical VAT ID, country, and VIES/registry status; (B) per-seller recommended tax treatment (collect VAT / reverse-charge / hold and require proof); and (C) a short remediation report with auto-fix suggestions (format normalization, possible country redirect).

Quick clarifying items so we scope this correctly:
- For sellers registered in the UK, do you want us to run GB-specific checks (HMRC VAT) in addition to VIES?
- For merchants marked as marketplaces (you mentioned autopayout), should the recommendation prefer platform-collect where possible or prioritize seller-responsibility?
- Do you have an existing webhook endpoint we can post the reconciled CSV to, or would you prefer a Drive link?

I’m proposing the following pilot plan:
1) You provide a CSV with the fields: seller_id, declared_vatid, country, invoice_example_id, contact_email. (I attached our preferred template.)
2) Redwood runs validation against EU VIES + HMRC (where permitted) and flags soft-fails (format issues) vs hard-fails (not registered).
3) We return a reconciliation CSV and an actionable remediation playbook — we can optionally run an automated email for soft-fails if you provide email content.

If that works I’ll loop in Ben and Marissa to outline automation and SLA.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, Billing & Payments
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vatid_bulk_template.csv
From: Sophie Mallory <sophie.mallory@greenwave.co>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@greenwave.co>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:04:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT IDs + split settlement for marketplace sellers

Thanks Neha — answers inline:  
- Yes please include HMRC (GB) checks — we have UK sellers and we need the separate lookup.
- For marketplace transactions prioritize platform-collect for low-risk (EU B2C under threshold) but for clearly B2B where reverse-charge applies please recommend reverse-charge. We’ll accept your recommendation column and our ops team will make final call.
- Drive link is preferred.

I uploaded a 2k-row sample to the Drive link below; it follows the template you attached. Can you confirm ETA for a pilot run on ~2k sellers? We need results before Nov 10 for the月-end settlement.

Drive: https://drive.greenwave.co/seller-vatid-sample

Best,
Sophie
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT IDs + split settlement for marketplace sellers — infra and automation notes

Looping internal ops notes here so we have a clear remediation approach. Key points: 

1) Validation stack: run VIES first, fallback to national registries (HMRC for GB, Agenzia delle Entrate for IT, etc.). Cache results for 30 days to avoid query throttles.
2) Scoring model: status -> {valid, invalid, soft-fail}. Soft-fail = format mismatch or country code mismatch (e.g., missing prefix). Add an "auto_fix" suggestion column for common fixes.
3) Tax treatment recommendation: create a deterministic rule engine with following outputs: collect_vat, reverse_charge, hold_for_proof. Rules consider seller_country, buyer_country, declared_vatid_status, invoice_amount, and marketplace_flag. We'll draft the rulebook (initial version attached).
4) Email remediation: for soft-fails, send templated email with suggested correction and a 7-day deadline. For hard-fails, hold payout and notify finance/ops with attachment checklist.
5) Deliverables & ETA: pilot run for 2k rows — 48 hours once we have the CSV and Drive access. We’ll provide reconciled CSV and remediation report.

Please confirm we can use the Drive upload and I’ll kick off the job.

-Ben
Principal Payments Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: remediation-rulebook-draft.md
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Mallory <sophie.mallory@greenwave.co>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Finance Team <finance@greenwave.co>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT IDs + split settlement for marketplace sellers — pilot confirmed

Sophie / Finance team — confirmed. Redwood will: 
- Pull the Drive file and validate each declared_vatid against VIES + HMRC where applicable.
- Return a reconciled CSV with columns: seller_id, declared_vatid, canonical_vatid, registry_checked, registry_status, auto_fix_suggestion, tax_treatment_recommendation, manual_review_flag, evidence_required.
- Provide a remediation report with templated emails for soft-fails and a hold-playbook for hard-fails.
- Pilot ETA: 48 hours (results posted to your Drive folder and a HubSpot activity).

Next steps for GreenWave: share the Drive link with edit permission for redwood_inference@redwood.ai and confirm whether you want us to run the soft-fail email campaign automatically or deliver only the CSV + templates.

I’ll start the validation job as soon as we have Drive access. Thanks — we’ll aim to have the pilot output by Nov 5 EOD.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, Billing & Payments
Redwood Inference
